articles.title: Thailand opens door to locally listed bitcoin and ether ETFs
articles.snippet: Thailand’s new crypto rules taking effect Oct. 16. They allow Thai asset managers to launch crypto ETFs on the local stock exchange, with bitcoin and ether initially eligible.

articles.title: ‘No going back’ for institutions moving toward tokenized onchain future, says Fidelity
articles.snippet: Tokenization offers structural advantages to financial institutions and helps asset managers reach new markets, according to Fidelity’s head of digital asset strategists.

articles.title: From Stellar to Canton: How Franklin Templeton Adopted Tokenization
articles.snippet: Roger Bayston, Head of Digital Assets at Franklin Templeton, unpacks how one of the world's largest asset managers embraced tokenization.
